visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized graphic showing a person's face receiving an injection, overlaid with heavy radial motion lines to signify distress and pain. The text "你還在打這種..." appears in a playful white font. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the clinical yet exaggerated nature of the illustration meant to capture attention. (2) A real-life main character, a young woman with dark hair, is shown lying on a treatment bed. A clinician wearing white gloves uses a high-tech white device and a syringe on her cheek. The background is a clean, white-walled medical room with sterile equipment and professional studio-grade lighting. (3) The main character walks through an urban street and enters a clinic with a large glass storefront. The signage "PPEUM Global" is clearly visible above the door. She is dressed in a smart-casual white top and gray trousers, carrying a pink bag. The outdoor lighting is natural, bright, and clear. (4) Inside, the clinic lobby is spacious and modern with curved white counters and recessed ceiling lights. The character sits at a consultation desk, interacting with two staff members dressed in black uniforms. A printed price list and a card payment terminal are placed on the table between them. (5) A staff member leads the woman into a private VIP treatment suite. The room contains a single treatment bed with a gray towel, a vanity with a mirror, and soft, warm decorative lighting. The walls feature a subtle floral or nature-themed wallpaper, creating a luxurious and private atmosphere. (6) A detailed graphic animation shows golden-colored droplets penetrating a pink, cellular skin surface model. Text overlays describe the "Potenza" benefits, specifically collagen production and wrinkle improvement. The graphic uses vivid yellow and pink tones to illustrate the scientific process of the treatment effectively. (7) The character is shown back in the treatment phase, with close-ups of the "Fillroad" product packaging. The clinician demonstrates the new, sealed needle tips being attached to the device. The lighting remains bright and clinical, focusing on the precision of the hands and the medical tools being used. (8) The final sequence shows the character's face in various stages of recovery. First, with small red bumps immediately after treatment, then a transition to her having perfectly smooth, radiant skin. She is smiling and touching her cheek, wearing light-colored pajamas in a home setting with soft natural light.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy electronic pop BGM featuring a driving drum beat and shimmering synthesizers. A female narrator delivers a high-arousal introduction with a bright, energetic pitch. Her speech is fast and enunciated, typical of a professional promotional vlog style. (2) As the visual shifts to the treatment, a digital "whoosh" sound effect marks the transition. The music continues at a consistent tempo of approximately 128 BPM. The narrator's tone becomes more explanatory, describing the sensations of the procedure while maintaining a positive and upbeat valence. (3) During the consultation scenes, the BGM volume is slightly ducked to prioritize the narrator's clear voice. Subtle ambient studio silence is maintained, with very low-level incidental noises like the rustle of clothing and the faint sound of a card machine's digital beep when processing a payment. (4) Throughout the description of the clinic's VIP rooms and services, the music's melodic line becomes more rhythmic. The narrator uses rising intonations to create excitement about the facilities. Occasional sound effects like "ding" or "pop" coincide with text overlays appearing on the screen. (5) In the final phase, as the results are shown, the music swells with a more triumphant and bright harmonic texture. The narrator's voice concludes with a friendly call to action. The track ends with a clean audio cut followed by a short reverb tail, ensuring a professional and polished finish.

It emphasizes convenience for Chinese-speaking tourists through translation services and the painless, effective nature of the procedure to attract beauty-conscious viewers.
